8/G.goal: Explain the purpose of a VR system and characterize its central technological and psychological issues through the definitions, qualities, differences, and relationship of immersion and presence.
8/G.achieves: Provides the foundational human-factor concepts needed to understand and address XR challenges, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system.

8/O1.goal: Characterize the main issues of a VR system as immersion and presence by explaining the system’s purpose, their definitions, their qualities, their differences, and their relationship.
8/O1.achieves: Establishes the foundational human-factor vocabulary needed to evaluate VR experiences and to study later XR issues, human factors, and optimization.
